class.name: IfcCsgPrimitive3D
class.brief_description: IfcCsgPrimitive3D is an abstract supertype of all three dimensional primitives used as either tree root item, or as Boolean results within a CSG solid model. All 3D CSG primitives are defined within a three-dimensional placement coordinate system. NOTEÿ No directly corresponding ISO 10303-42 entity, the select type primitive_3d covers the same individual 3D CSG primitives, the position attribute h

members.member: The placement coordinate system to which the parameters of each individual CSG primitive apply.
